messages:
maya_sales: FYI Cygnus (lead: @jordan) just sent an RFP follow-up. They want a short eval + capability matrix focused on: private VPC deployment, HSM/KMS, quantized model variants, and expected P50/P95 latencies for streaming chat. Can we sketch answers and a POC plan by EOD tomorrow?

ajit_se: I can draft the POC runbook. Q: do they want Dedicated or Private? That changes cost and timeline a lot.

maya_sales: They prefer Private (customer-managed VPC) but are open to Dedicated if Private takes >3 weeks. Main constraint is data residency + HSM.

lana_security: For HSM we need to confirm supported vendors. We support AWS CloudHSM and partner HSM via PKCS11. Also need to know whether customer requires split trust / dual control.

clare_legal: Heads-up: Cygnus asked for a copy of our standard DPA + a note on data deletion window in Private mode. I can attach the DPA PDF once we confirm deployment mode.

ajit_se: Drafting capability matrix now. I'll include rows: deployment modes, KMS/HSM support, network peering (VPC peering vs transit), model pinning/versions, rollout controls (canary/A-B), token-level cost, latency SLOs.

simon_prod: For latency numbers, we should give representative baselines: e.g. 8B quantized on a4g equivalent -> P50 ~ 40ms per token streaming, P95 ~ 120ms with 1-2 concurrent requests per GPU. I'll add notes about batch sizing and KV-caching assumptions.

maya_sales: Good — also Cygnus asked about fallback behavior if HSM is unreachable. They want to know if we can fall back to software-encrypted keys temporarily. Is that allowed?

lana_security: We cannot automatically fall back to software keys for HSM-protected tenants without explicit contract exception. We can offer a documented emergency unseal procedure with on-call approval. Add that to the response.

ajit_se: POC plan (high level):
1) Week 0: NDA + access exchange
2) Week 1: Private control-plane install in their VPC (airgap optional) + KMS integration test
3) Week 2: Deploy quantized model variant, run 5k sample conversations, collect latency/cost metrics
4) Week 3: Security/ops handoff + runbook + SLA template walkthrough

(Adding these to the matrix doc.)

maya_sales: Pricing question: they asked for a 3-month proof-of-value quote vs committed Dedicated pricing. Can someone outline delta (hosted vs dedicated vs private) in $/1000 tokens equivalent?

simon_prod: Quick ballpark (to refine): Hosted API: $X per 1k tokens; Dedicated: baseline reserved GPU + lower per-token; Private: platform license + infra OPEX. I'll put placeholders and a short formula showing how we calculate per-token for Dedicated and Private so sales can plug numbers.

clare_legal: Also they want to know breach notification timing and audit log retention in Private installs. Our standard is 72 hours for notification and 13 months logs by default; can extend for enterprise. Include note we can negotiate retention but it impacts cost.

ajit_se: Pasting example config snippet we'll give them in the technical appendix:
```
# sample redwood private deploy snippet
deployment:
  mode: private
  vpc: vpc-0a1b2c3d
  kms_provider: aws_cloudhsm
  caching:
    kv_cache: enabled
    prefix_cache_ttl: 120s
  quantization_profile: int8s-optimized
  rollout:
    canary: 10%
    max_surge: 1
```

maya_sales: Perfect. Can someone attach the capability matrix + runbook links here? I'll send to Cygnus after legal approves DPA snippet.

devops_bot: Attachment uploaded: https://redwood-files.internal/sales/cygnus/capability-matrix-v1.xlsx (view restricted).

clare_legal: Uploaded DPA excerpt here: https://redwood-files.internal/legal/dpa-excerpt-cygnus.pdf. I added the deletion window and notification language.

lana_security: Quick checklist to include in the RFP response: encryption at rest (HSM), in-transit TLS, private control plane, audit logs, SIEM integration via syslog/forwarder. I'll add short answers to each.

maya_sales: Great — plan: ajit will finish matrix + runbook by 17:00 PT, clare will confirm DPA edits by 16:00, lana will sign off security Qs by 16:30. If all green, I'll send to Cygnus at 17:30. @channel :thumbsup:

ajit_se: On it.

lana_security: Will review.

clare_legal: Approved with minor edits.

maya_sales: Thanks team — I'll queue up a quick sync if needed.

[thread closed]"
